motion_tests.notes: Gate bottom clearance 0.35 / 0.45 / 0.60mm over local card floor. Fixed screw axis at Z72 travels in recessed elongated slot.

motion_tests.test: both card sizes and descending optional weight
motion_tests.notes: 57x87 with two P12 spacers and exit sensor shifted inward 1.5mm; 60x96 without spacers. Weight positions for 1/13/54/108 cards at reference thickness 0.30mm.
One 0.30mm card translated along inclined local X by 0..150mm in 2mm steps for both sizes. Rigid card path only; no ballistic flight, bending, double-feed or friction simulation.

motion_tests.test: lower preassembled upper cover over head
motion_tests.notes: UI/PCF/DRV and cover panels preinstalled, three bottom mounting screws fitted afterwards. Shroud lowered vertically from +80mm in 2mm steps. Deck is unloaded and optional weights absent.
Hatch approaches along +Y from 20mm outside. Four hatch screws installed after seating; no card stack loaded.

Preassembled P04A/P04B with four deck screws/nuts lowered through P02A/P02B/P03/6005 before collar/base installed. P06 with captured nut but without radial screw then slides UP onto exposed journal from below; collar cannot snap sideways over shaft.

Pedestals with bearings and upper blocks slide onto shafts from OUTSIDE along Y before fixing to P31; P22 coupling, RF motor, guide and housing fitted later. Only that declared subassembly is checked for insertion.

motion_tests.test: split hubs and clamp screws rotate
motion_tests.notes: Four drive groups, every 5 degrees. Clamp screws/nuts rotate with their hub. Slots and clamp forces are not a deformation/torque proof.

motion_tests.test: upper unit to base before underside slip-ring screws
motion_tests.notes: Flange and three P36 clips/captive nuts prelocated as upper unit. Lower vertically by 60mm in 2mm steps; slip M3x8, stepper and base fastening screws installed afterwards. Pegs are reference flange locators, not M2 screws.
P33 and its screws removed. A reserved 3mm-diameter L-tool with 12mm short leg enters along +Y. Longer ordinary hex keys are not certified to fit; adjust before fitting cover if needed.
Reference 10mm-wide x6mm-high molded plug body stays outside X=-83; 6.7x2.6mm metal tip protrudes 3.3mm. TypeC receptacle solid excluded as the intended mating envelope.

limitations: 1-degree yaw and discrete insertion/travel samples are not a continuous swept-volume proof.
PCB solder, terminals, exact switch stroke, cell model, purchased-part tolerances and flexible wire harness are not fully specified.
No physical printing, slicer/support validation, feeding-speed, force/friction, durability or electrical test performed.
